title: Sunday · fifteen
logline: The fifteenth September 12, taken early on a Sunday: Gully's counter, the corn, the end stool, and a man asleep on it at noon after a night shift, Gully letting him.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a man asleep upright on the end stool at noon, arms folded, a tray of corn untouched before him.

image.prompt: a thin man asleep sitting upright on a shop's end stool with his arms folded and a tray of corn untouched before him, watercolor

panels.name: Asleep

panels.composition: Tier 2: Gully behind the counter, wiping, not waking him, the corkboard above.

image.prompt: a stocky man in an apron wiping a counter and not waking the man asleep at its end, a corkboard above, watercolor

panels.name: Gully

panels.composition: Tier 3: the shop from the door: the stool empty, the tray empty, a coffee cup washed on the rack.

image.prompt: a small shop's counter from its door with an empty end stool, an empty paper tray and a washed cup on a rack, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Later

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Fifteen. Asleep at the counter; let.
